transcript.answer: The OpenTelemetry metrics API, unlike its tracing API, has no proxy meter. If you create an instrument from `metrics.getMeter()` before a `MeterProvider` is registered, you get a permanent no-op that never records, even after a provider is registered later. Lore hit this in `libs/server-core/src/outbound/otel.ts`. It created its instruments at import time, and the entrypoint imported that module before `initOtel()` ran. As a result `lore.http.requests`, `lore.tool.calls` and the other counters never recorded anything. The fix (ADR-050, PR #2652) moved the instruments to `libs/shared/src/outbound/otel/metrics.ts`. They are now resolved lazily at record time against the currently registered global meter provider, memoized per provider.

judgements.reason: The answer states that the metrics API has no proxy meter, that instruments created before provider registration stay no-op permanently, and that Lore now resolves instruments lazily against the current provider, matching all essentials of the gold answer.
